spans.title: The Reporter's Unruly Ears
spans.blurb: A newsroom tyrant glares from his throne at Jimmy Price, a first rate reporter cursed with ears that wiggle on their own whenever excitement strikes.

spans.title: One Last Cigarette
spans.blurb: Handcuffed in a shabby room, a burglar learns murder now hangs over him. He begs for one cigarette, and his slow mind starts moving very fast.

books.pairNote: A newsroom character sketch and a criminal's escape; no shared scenes, characters, or reveals.

spans.title: No Trout Today
spans.blurb: A restless young detective daydreams of trout streams through a slow spring morning, until one short phone call snaps every fiber of him awake.

spans.title: The Proposal in the Rain
spans.blurb: In a rain washed midnight cab, Donald finally speaks his love. Mary trembles at her own doorstep, haunted by something she cannot bring herself to name.

books.pairNote: Both circle the same Waverly Place address from opposite angles, but they share no text and neither hands over the other's payoff.

spans.title: Enter Moris Klaw
spans.blurb: Into a hushed crime scene shuffles an ancient stranger in a caped cloak, spraying scent on his brow and announcing that he smells dead men.

spans.title: The Danbazzar Papyrus
spans.blurb: A dealer in smuggled antiquities spreads a stained papyrus before a rich collector and his son, promising secrets no living man has heard since the pharaohs.

spans.title: The Duel by Torchlight
spans.blurb: Torches ring a midnight field as two knights break lance after lance before the lady Gabrielle, one riding with grace, the other with fury.

spans.title: Freia's Altar
spans.blurb: A woodsman climbs to a forbidden pagan altar and meets a veiled figure claiming to be a goddess returned, with two iron knights at her call.

spans.title: Among the Walking Trees
spans.blurb: Stranded on a strange world, a traveler flees a bellowing bull and climbs the nearest tree, which slaps him down and files charges.

spans.title: Finding Alexander Selkirk
spans.blurb: Privateers anchoring at a lonely island find not a prize but a ragged Scot who has survived there alone for four years, hiding from every wrong flag.

spans.title: Wreck of the Speedwell
spans.blurb: A gale drives a ship onto the rocks. The survivors build a new vessel from her bones while discipline rots and the crew writes its own law.

books.pairNote: Two separate true episodes from different voyages, a castaway's rescue and a shipwreck ordeal, with no shared text or characters.

spans.title: The Knife Between His Teeth
spans.blurb: Bound to a cot while a sinister surgeon prepares his instruments and sponge of ether, Cole has one knife within reach and only seconds to use it.

spans.title: The Cat in the Dark Cell
spans.blurb: In the black punishment cells a prisoner strokes a visiting cat, praying the guard will not notice what his fingers have found under her fur.

spans.title: Up From the Punishment Block
spans.blurb: Out of a lightless punishment block a prisoner creeps toward the one locked door, meaning to free his broken comrades or die at the top of the stairs.

books.pairNote: Consecutive beats of one escape; the story presumes the sawing happened but never restages the cat's secret, so each keeps its own punch.
